== Summary ==
Identified: [[Robbie Hendon]] (standing, green Dallas Stars cap and grey shirt; same cap as [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] and [[:File:2021 World Championship between rounds 2.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled: seated player in glasses, a white respirator, and a black shirt lettered N+1 (same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship player during a match 1.jpg]]); player in a red shirt, a blue neck gaiter, and an In my lifetime forearm tattoo; player in a tan cap and a black shirt.
Games in the side-event room, with a spectator standing. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).
